head: Claude Opus 5.6 rumors: testers say Anthropic is trying a new model
dek: Some Claude users on X say their chats were answered by an unannounced model they call Opus 5.6, according to posts gathered by TestingCatalog on 24 and 25 November. Anthropic hasn't announced or confirmed it.
details: One tester, Leo, wrote that the model seems to be tested with a subset of users, some in Claude Code, some in the Claude chat app and some in neither. Another tester said their run was routed from "Opus 5.5 Extra" and shared a Claude Code screenshot. Testers posted animations and 3D scenes they say the model made in code, but TestingCatalog notes these are early, hand-picked results and that the Opus 5.6 label can't be verified. Anthropic's newest released models are Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, out since 9 November.
where: Reportedly some Claude users in the chat app and Claude Code; not confirmed
means: If you use Claude, a few of your answers may already come from a model in testing, but nothing changes in your plan or app settings.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Anthropic hasn't said when or whether a new Opus model comes out.
